headline: RapWire 24/7: Five distinct stories — Sept. 23, 2026
body: This verified five-slide RapWire news carousel covers five distinct current stories: J. Cole launching the Indie 5000 in Fayetteville; 50 Cent unveiling the Headcrack casino dice game; two new Tim Westwood charges; Snoop Dogg hosting the 2026 VMAs; and Rockstar testimony about reported GTA 6 anti-leak security measures. Each story is separately sourced, visually identified, and labeled with context and attribution.
caption:
#RapWire24/7 — five distinct stories for Sept. 23, 2026.
1) J. Cole is launching his independently developed Indie 5000 sneaker in Fayetteville, North Carolina, on Sept. 23 — the same day he returns to his hometown for the Crown Coliseum stop.
Sources: https://sneakernews.com/2026/09/22/j-cole-shoes-dreamer-indie-5000/ | https://www.aol.com/articles/j-coles-sneaker-set-debut-171759000.html
2) Curtis “50 Cent” Jackson and TCSJOHNHUXLEY are bringing the licensed Headcrack live casino dice game to G2E Las Vegas, Sept. 29–Oct. 1. It adapts the street game Cee-Lo for a casino table.
Sources: https://fairsonline.org/?page=6 | https://www.tmz.com/2026/09/22/50-cent-has-new-game-at-las-vegas-casinos/
Handles: @50cent
3) London’s Metropolitan Police announced two additional charges against Tim Westwood. He now faces 17 charges involving nine women; the original case is scheduled for trial in January 2027. The allegations have not been proven in court.
Sources: https://news.met.police.uk/news/metropolitan-police-service-charges-tim-westwood-with-further-offences-513128 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ex-BBC-Radio-DJ-Westwood-charged-with-two-further-sexual-assault-charges-ce785ad8df89/
4) Snoop Dogg will host the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards in Los Angeles on Sept. 27. MTV’s official voting page is live, including the Best Hip-Hop category.
Sources: https://apnews.com/article/c4774a75093c5b98626d727a5544b8c7 | https://vote.mtv.com/best-hip-hop
Handles: @SnoopDogg · @vmas
5) In a Glasgow employment tribunal, Rockstar filings and reporting described blackmail attempts and drone fly-bys that led to privacy film on office windows. These are claims in the case, not a gameplay reveal.
Sources: https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/rockstar-says-people-seeking-gta-6-updates-have-led-to-hackers-blackmailing-over-leaks-and-drones-being-used-to-spy-on-devs/ | https://www.gamedeveloper.com/production/rockstar-and-fired-gta-developers-outline-core-arguments-during-union-busting-tribunal
Handles: @RockstarGames

@Rapwire247
